infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Longlivy uses the camera to scan food barcodes and photograph meals for AI-assisted logging.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Longlivy can use photos from your library to log a meal with AI-assisted recognition.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Longlivy uses the microphone so you can dictate a meal description using your keyboard's voice input.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Longlivy uses your location to record the route, distance and pace of GPS-based activities like running or cycling.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Longlivy uses Bluetooth to connect to your Noise smartwatch and read live activity data.
